prompt: Vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts thumbnail in the style of a bold Japanese tech-news magazine cover. ONE single continuous illustration filling the whole canvas edge to edge (no panels, no frames, no collage, no blurred edges); every area has a role, no empty space. LAYOUT (percent from the top): the title block sits in the upper half, from 13% to 50%, three tiers with strong size contrast: tier 1 = a medium white word with a thick navy outline; tier 2 = the biggest, heaviest words, slightly tilted, in bright yellow or red with a thick dark outline and a deep 3D extrusion shadow, large but inside the safe margins; tier 3 = a small white text on a colored ribbon or banner. The girl (the attached character: same face, silver braided hair, blue jacket) is in the lower part, her head at about 50% and her body down to the bottom edge, taking about 40% of the image height, slightly right of center, holding or using the topic object described below; the topic object and the scene fill the rest of the lower part. Clean bold 2D anime style, vivid saturated colors, strong contrast, strong rim light. SAFE MARGINS: every letter of every text (all tiers and badges) and the girl's face must stay at least 12% of the image height away from the top and bottom edges and at least 6% of the width away from the left and right edges; the top line of the title must NOT touch the top edge and no text may touch the sides. The background, her body and objects still extend to all edges. All Japanese text perfectly spelled exactly as given, no other text, no real brand logos, no watermark. No tiny decorative patterns or sparkles. Colors: dark navy with glowing cyan and purple neon. Scene: on the left a messy cloud of blank scattered sticky notes, a big bold arrow, on the right the same notes neatly arranged into a timeline of blank boxes; the girl stands in front holding a smartphone, amazed delighted face, bold diagonal two-color split background. Title: tier 1 'Claudeの新ボード'; tier 2 '散らかった案を整理' (yellow); tier 3 ribbon (orange) '話すだけで図に'. Also a small red tilted badge 'β版' inside the safe margins on the left, near 48%. No characters from any existing anime other than the girl, no real app screenshots, no Anthropic or Claude logos, the board shapes and sticky notes are blank (no letters or numbers on them), no readable text except the title and badge. STRICT WIDTH LIMIT: every text line, including the biggest tier 2 words, must be NARROWER than 80% of the image width and centered horizontally, leaving clear background on both sides of every line (at least 10% of the width on the left and on the right); if a line is long, make its letters smaller or break it into two lines rather than reaching the edges. The badge sits at least 10% of the width away from the left edge. The top line of text (tier 1) starts at about 17% from the top, with plain background above it. The badge is at least 12% of the width from the left edge.
